{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sample_seq to see if any patient has multiple entries
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_counts.max()}")
print(f"Patients with multiple sample_seq: {sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()}")"}
